# Laptop Prices in Kenya 2026: 349 Laptops Analyzed

> The median laptop at ECB Technologies costs KSh 52,000, across 349 laptops priced from KSh 16,000 to KSh 324,000. 75 of 349 laptops (21%) cost under KSh 30,000; 62 (18%) cost KSh 120,000 or more.

Canonical: https://www.ecbtechkenya.com/research/laptop-prices-kenya
Last updated: 2026-11-25 (when the catalogue last changed)

## Key findings

1. The median laptop at ECB Technologies costs KSh 52,000, across 349 laptops priced from KSh 16,000 to KSh 324,000. ([link](https://www.ecbtechkenya.com/research/laptop-prices-kenya#median-laptop-price))
2. 75 of 349 laptops (21%) cost under KSh 30,000; 62 (18%) cost KSh 120,000 or more. ([link](https://www.ecbtechkenya.com/research/laptop-prices-kenya#laptops-under-30000))
3. The median Core i7 laptop costs KSh 52,000, KSh 21,000 more than the median Core i5 laptop (KSh 31,000); based on 132 Core i7 and 90 Core i5 laptops. ([link](https://www.ecbtechkenya.com/research/laptop-prices-kenya#core-i7-vs-core-i5))
4. HP makes 174 of the 349 laptops (50%), more than any other brand. ([link](https://www.ecbtechkenya.com/research/laptop-prices-kenya#most-common-laptop-brand))
5. Laptops with an Intel Core Ultra processor have a median price of KSh 145,500 across 46 models, the newest Intel generation in stock. ([link](https://www.ecbtechkenya.com/research/laptop-prices-kenya#core-ultra-laptop-price))
6. 47 laptops with an 8th-generation or newer Intel Core i5 or i7 cost KSh 40,000 or less; the cheapest is KSh 25,000. ([link](https://www.ecbtechkenya.com/research/laptop-prices-kenya#student-laptops-under-40000))
7. 145 of the 191 Core i5 and Core i7 laptops whose name states a generation (76%) are 8th generation or newer, the oldest Intel chips Windows 11 supports. ([link](https://www.ecbtechkenya.com/research/laptop-prices-kenya#8th-gen-or-newer-share))

## Questions

### How much does a laptop cost in Kenya?

At ECB Technologies in Nairobi, laptops cost from KSh 16,000 to KSh 324,000, with a median of KSh 52,000 across 349 laptops. 75 (21%) cost under KSh 30,000. ([link](https://www.ecbtechkenya.com/research/laptop-prices-kenya#how-much-does-a-laptop-cost-in-kenya))

### How much is a Core i5 laptop in Kenya?

Core i5 laptops at ECB Technologies start at KSh 21,000; the median is KSh 31,000 across 90 models. ([link](https://www.ecbtechkenya.com/research/laptop-prices-kenya#core-i5-laptop-price-kenya))

### How much is a Core i7 laptop in Kenya?

Core i7 laptops at ECB Technologies start at KSh 22,000; the median is KSh 52,000 across 132 models. ([link](https://www.ecbtechkenya.com/research/laptop-prices-kenya#core-i7-laptop-price-kenya))

### What is the cheapest laptop at ECB Technologies?

The cheapest laptop is Lenovo THINKPAD 11E CELERON 4GB 128GB NON TOUCH at KSh 16,000. ([link](https://www.ecbtechkenya.com/research/laptop-prices-kenya#cheapest-laptop-kenya))

### How many good laptops are there under KSh 40,000?

47 laptops with an 8th-gen or newer Core i5/i7 cost KSh 40,000 or less, from KSh 25,000. ([link](https://www.ecbtechkenya.com/research/laptop-prices-kenya#best-laptop-under-40000-kenya))

### Which laptop brand has the most models?

HP, with 174 of 349 laptops (50%). ([link](https://www.ecbtechkenya.com/research/laptop-prices-kenya#most-common-laptop-brand-kenya))

## Methodology

- Source: every product listed on www.ecbtechkenya.com, read from the shop's own catalogue at the time shown below.
- Prices are the current listed prices in Kenyan shillings, as shown on each product page.
- Excluded: listings without a usable price (under KSh 1,000 or over KSh 2,000,000) and duplicate listings of the same product.
- Brand, processor and generation come from the product names as typed by the shop; products whose name doesn't state them are left out of those tables.
- Findings with fewer than 20 products behind them are not shown; differences within 5% are reported as about the same.
- Medians are rounded to the nearest shilling; shares to whole percent (band and category shares add up to 100%).
- Refreshed automatically when the catalogue changes; data last changed 25 November 2026.

# Laptop and Phone Delivery Across Kenya

> ECB Technologies delivers laptops, phones and accessories across Nairobi by rider and to all 47 counties by courier. Free pickup on Moi Avenue, Nairobi CBD.

Canonical: https://www.ecbtechkenya.com/delivery
Last updated: 2026-11-26

## Delivery across Kenya

We deliver laptops, phones, printers and accessories to all 47 counties in Kenya. In Nairobi, our own riders bring your order to you. Everywhere else, we send it by courier. You can also collect your order free from our shop.

## Three ways to get your order

**1. Rider delivery within Nairobi:** our riders deliver to your home or office anywhere in Nairobi County.

**2. Courier delivery to the rest of Kenya:** we send your order by courier to your town, in all 47 counties.

**3. Free pickup in Nairobi CBD:** collect from our shop at Techmart Iconic Business Plaza, 3rd Floor, Room T12, Moi Avenue, Nairobi CBD.

The delivery cost for your location is shown at checkout before you pay. For delivery times to your area, chat with us on WhatsApp: [0717 040 531](https://wa.me/254717040531).

## Rider delivery in Nairobi

Our riders cover all of Nairobi County, including Nairobi CBD, Westlands, Parklands, Kilimani, Kileleshwa, Lavington, Upper Hill, Karen, Lang'ata, South B, South C, Industrial Area, Eastleigh, Kasarani, Roysambu, Ruaraka, Embakasi, Donholm, Buruburu, Umoja, Kayole, Dagoretti, Kawangware, Kibra and Mathare.

## Courier delivery to all 47 counties

**Nairobi region:** Nairobi (by rider)

**Central:** Kiambu (Thika, Ruiru, Kikuyu, Limuru), Kirinyaga (Kerugoya, Kutus), Murang'a, Nyandarua (Ol Kalou), Nyeri (Nyeri, Karatina)

**Coast:** Mombasa, Kwale (Ukunda, Diani), Kilifi (Malindi, Kilifi), Tana River (Hola), Lamu, Taita-Taveta (Voi, Taveta)

**Eastern:** Marsabit, Isiolo, Meru, Tharaka-Nithi (Chuka), Embu, Kitui, Machakos (Machakos, Athi River), Makueni (Wote, Kibwezi)

**North Eastern:** Garissa, Wajir, Mandera

**Nyanza:** Kisumu, Siaya, Homa Bay, Migori, Kisii, Nyamira

**Rift Valley:** Turkana (Lodwar), West Pokot (Kapenguria), Samburu (Maralal), Trans Nzoia (Kitale), Uasin Gishu (Eldoret), Elgeyo-Marakwet (Iten), Nandi (Kapsabet), Baringo (Kabarnet), Laikipia (Nanyuki), Nakuru (Nakuru, Naivasha), Narok, Kajiado (Kitengela, Ngong, Ongata Rongai), Kericho, Bomet

**Western:** Kakamega, Vihiga, Bungoma, Busia

Don't see your town? Message us on WhatsApp on [0717 040 531](https://wa.me/254717040531) and we'll tell you how we can get your order to you.

## Questions

**Do you deliver outside Nairobi?**

Yes. We deliver to all 47 counties in Kenya by courier.

Yes. Our own riders deliver anywhere in Nairobi County.

Yes, for free. We're at Techmart Iconic Business Plaza, 3rd Floor, Room T12, Moi Avenue, Nairobi CBD.

**Can I see the product before I buy?**

Yes. Visit the shop and our team will show you.

# HP vs Dell vs Lenovo Laptops in Kenya

> HP vs Dell vs Lenovo laptops in Kenya compared: models, starting and typical prices at ECB Technologies, Moi Avenue, Nairobi CBD. Updated 15 November 2026.

Canonical: https://www.ecbtechkenya.com/hp-vs-dell-vs-lenovo-laptops-kenya
Last updated: 2026-11-26

**At ECB Technologies, HP has the most laptops (172 models), and the lowest starting price is Lenovo at KSh 16,000.** The table compares the HP, Dell and Lenovo laptops we stock, with prices checked on 15 November 2026.

## HP vs Dell vs Lenovo: models and prices

| Brand | Laptops | From | Typical (median) | Up to | Most common series |

## Which series is which?

- **HP EliteBook and ProBook, Dell Latitude, Lenovo ThinkPad** are business laptop lines, built for daily office use.
- **HP OMEN and Victus** are HP's gaming laptops; see [gaming](https://www.ecbtechkenya.com/category/gaming).
- **Dell XPS, HP Spectre and Envy, Lenovo Yoga** are thin and light premium laptops.
- **HP ZBook and Dell Precision** are workstations for design, engineering and video work.

# Privacy policy

> How ECB Technologies collects and uses personal information.

Canonical: https://www.ecbtechkenya.com/privacy
Last updated: 2026-11-26

## **Privacy Policy**

**Effective Date: [8-24-2024]**

At Genius Shop, we value your privacy and are committed to protecting your personal information. This Privacy Policy outlines how we collect, use, share, and protect your data when you use our platform. By using Genius Shop, you agree to the terms of this Privacy Policy. Please take a moment to read it carefully.

### **1. Information We Collect**

We collect various types of information to provide and improve our services, ensure the security of our platform, and enhance your shopping experience.

#### **a. Personal Information**

- **Account Information:** When you create an account with Genius Shop, we collect personal details such as your name, email address, phone number, and password.
- **Payment Information:** To process your transactions, we collect payment details such as your credit card number, billing address, and other related information. We do not store your payment information on our servers; it is securely handled by our third-party payment processors.
- **Shipping Information:** We collect your shipping address and contact information to fulfill your orders and ensure timely delivery.

#### **b. Non-Personal Information**

- **Usage Data:** We collect information about how you use our platform, including your browsing history, search queries, and interaction with products and services.
- **Device Information:** We gather details about the device you use to access Genius Shop, including IP address, browser type, operating system, and device identifiers.
- **Cookies and Tracking Technologies:** We use cookies, web beacons, and similar technologies to track your activity on our site, remember your preferences, and deliver personalized content and ads.

### **2. How We Use Your Information**

The information we collect is used for a variety of purposes, including:

- **Providing and Improving Our Services:** We use your information to process transactions, fulfill orders, provide customer support, and enhance your overall shopping experience.
- **Personalization:** We use your data to tailor content, recommendations, and advertisements to your interests and preferences.
- **Communication:** We may use your contact information to send you updates, newsletters, marketing materials, and other communications related to Genius Shop. You can opt out of marketing communications at any time.
- **Security and Fraud Prevention:** We use your information to protect the integrity of our platform, prevent unauthorized access, and detect and combat fraudulent activities.
- **Legal Compliance:** We may use your data to comply with legal obligations, enforce our terms and conditions, and respond to legal requests or inquiries.

### **3. How We Share Your Information**

We do not sell your personal information to third parties. However, we may share your information with trusted partners and service providers for the following purposes:

- **Service Providers:** We work with third-party companies to provide services such as payment processing, order fulfillment, shipping, customer support, and marketing. These service providers have access to your information only to perform specific tasks on our behalf and are obligated to protect your data.
- **Sellers:** When you make a purchase from a seller on Genius Shop, we share your relevant information, such as your shipping address and contact details, with the seller to facilitate order processing and delivery.
- **Business Transfers:** In the event of a merger, acquisition, or sale of assets, your information may be transferred to the new owner as part of the transaction.
- **Legal Requirements:** We may disclose your information if required by law or in response to a legal process, such as a court order, subpoena, or government request.

### **4. Your Rights and Choices**

You have several rights regarding your personal information, including:

- **Access and Update:** You can access and update your account information at any time by logging into your Genius Shop account.
- **Opt-Out:** You can opt out of receiving marketing communications from us by following the unsubscribe link in our emails or adjusting your account settings.
- **Data Portability:** You have the right to request a copy of the personal information we hold about you in a structured, commonly used, and machine-readable format.
- **Deletion:** You can request the deletion of your account and personal information by contacting our customer support team. Please note that we may retain certain information as required by law or for legitimate business purposes.

### **5. Data Security**

We take the security of your personal information seriously and implement a variety of measures to protect it. These include encryption, access controls, and regular security audits. However, no method of transmission over the internet or electronic storage is 100% secure, and we cannot guarantee absolute security.

### **6. Cookies and Tracking Technologies**

Genius Shop uses cookies and similar tracking technologies to enhance your experience on our platform. Cookies are small text files stored on your device that help us remember your preferences, track your activity, and deliver personalized content and ads.

You can manage your cookie preferences through your browser settings. However, disabling cookies may affect the functionality of our site and your ability to use certain features.

### **7. Third-Party Links**

Our platform may contain links to third-party websites or services that are not operated by Genius Shop. We are not responsible for the privacy practices of these third parties, and we encourage you to review their privacy policies before providing any personal information.

### **8. International Data Transfers**

Genius Shop operates globally, and your information may be transferred to and processed in countries outside of your own. We take steps to ensure that your data is treated securely and in accordance with this Privacy Policy, regardless of where it is processed.

### **9. Children's Privacy**

Genius Shop is not intended for use by individuals under the age of 13, and we do not knowingly collect personal information from children under 13. If we become aware that we have collected information from a child under 13, we will take steps to delete that information promptly.

### **10. Changes to This Privacy Policy**

We may update this Privacy Policy from time to time to reflect changes in our practices, legal requirements, or for other operational reasons. When we make changes, we will update the "Effective Date" at the top of this page and notify you through our platform or via email. We encourage you to review this Privacy Policy periodically to stay informed about how we protect your information.

### **11. Contact Us**

If you have any questions or concerns about this Privacy Policy or our data practices, please contact us at:
